title: ID0379415-DC/Si-D/FI-[GcIKxl] Not able to stop charging session
description:
Location:  Tampere Turtola
Reported behaviour/issue:
On DC1 (outlet number 11864) You are able to start charging session with the App but not end it. This has caused problems for many costumer. Other outlets you are able to start and stop the session. With RFID you are able to start and stop the session. Customer stated that the issue happened around 13.00 (UTC+3) at 13.9.2024, and then they tested again at 15.00 (UTC+3)

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0379415 - DC/Si-D/FI - Not able to stop charging session CRM:00315001769
additional_info.body:
Hello Francisco!
Thank you for the replay.
We went through these with costumer. They were able to confirm that
DC1 is the main unit right outlet (ID 11864 in their backend)
DC2 is the main unit left outlet (ID 11865 in their backend)
DC3 is the dispenser right outlet (ID 16621 in their backend)
DC4 is the dispenser left outlet (ID 16622 in their backend)
Could this issue be related to something still wrong with their backend?
Also what I found weird is that starting and stopping with RFID works fine. As I have understood for the charger it is basically the same if you start and stop with RFID or with APP.
Best regards

additional_info.subject: ID0379415-DC/Si-D/FI-Not able to stop charging session CRM:00315001769
additional_info.body:
Hi Sakari,
Thanks for the prompt response.
I have checked a session on DC1 that worked today with the RFID:
I believe this session ended correctly, if so, then the problem is somewhere in the RemoteStopTransaction. If this is the case, then the problem is not charger related.
We can still align if the problem is not indeed coming from the backend. If that is the case maybe I can bring some expertise from OCPP colleagues.
Let me know your thoughts.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0379415-DC/Si-D/FI-Not able to stop charging session CRM:00315001769
additional_info.body:
Hi Sakari, good afternoon.
As we already discussed this seems to be a backend issue. From our side everything points to the fact that the charger is not receiving the RemoteStopTransaction for the Remote sessions.
From RFID everything works, so it's impossible that it's a charger issue and all other outlets work perfectly.
What do you want do here ? Should I forward this ticket to you and you discuss with the backend? From our side there is really not much I do anymore :\
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
